title: Station Meridian Rising Again
author: Marguerite Oyelaran
blurb: Edmund Blackwood, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
